7\. Architects can read unrelated hands files 🐞 Bug ⛨ Security 
Reads adds the whole HANDS_DOCS directory as an architect read root rather than limiting access
to the handbook and templates. In a source-tree install, docs_root() can make that directory the
hands repository root, so guarded Bash reads also accept unrelated files under that repository.
